speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help you, please tell me how many years old you are and how severe the pain is on a scale of 1 to 10? Also, has the pain traveled below your knee or into your foot?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L4-L5 or L5-S1). The patient's sudden onset of back pain radiating down the leg and into the foot after exercise is classic for a herniated disc causing radiculopathy. I request the MRI of the lumbar spine to confirm the location and severity of the disc herniation.
